recommendation_summary: Act now: keep the existing tracker and replace the lead-only reviewer with a pool of the lead plus the two qualified approvers, requiring one approval. Add round-robin assignment, a 24h review SLA with automatic reassignment, removal of the lead from rotation when out of office, and reassignment of PRs currently waiting on the lead today. Optional additions: a WIP limit and a daily 15-minute async check of PRs waiting over 24h. Measure coding-done-to-approved time against the 3-day baseline. Squads/chapters, Jira Align and quarterly workshops are explicitly skipped. No unmet needs, but the reply has none of the required record labels.
note: A sound bounded reviewer-coverage fix that rejects the framed stack in prose, but none of the four labeled record lines are present, so every record predicate fails.
